    ba.beneregistry AS "Beneficiary Registry ID",

The report is sorted in ascending order based on the disaster-affected population. The distribution status is labeled as 'Resource Distribution Inequity' if the equity value is greater than 0.5, otherwise, it is labeled as 'Normal Distribution'.

events.sql:
SELECT
    ba.beneregistry AS "Beneficiary Registry ID",
    ba.distequityidx AS "Equity Value",
    CASE
        WHEN ba.distequityidx > 0.5 THEN 'Resource Distribution Inequity'
        ELSE 'Normal Distribution'
    END AS "Distribution Status",
    (de.impactmetrics->'population'->>'affected')::int AS "Disaster-Affected Population"
FROM
    beneficiariesandassessments AS ba
JOIN
    disasterevents AS de ON ba.benedistref = de.distregistry
ORDER BY
    "Disaster-Affected Population" ASC;
